description: This file contains setup and configuration logic for the Signal channel in the OpenClaw project, including input validation, prompting, and proxy creation for the setup wizard.

methods.name: normalizeSignalAccountInput
methods.description: Normalizes and validates a Signal account input, ensuring it is a valid E.164 number or null.

methods.name: parseSignalAllowFromEntries
methods.description: Parses a raw string of allowlist entries for Signal, supporting UUIDs and E.164 numbers.

methods.name: buildSignalSetupPatch
methods.description: Builds a configuration patch object for Signal setup based on provided input fields.

methods.name: promptSignalAllowFrom
methods.description: Prompts the user to input Signal allowlist entries, with validation and existing config retrieval.
